examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The compound composition form: the full pagination assembled by hand from the dot-notation sub-components — page-info text (`Pagination.Info`), Previous / numbers / overflow / Next (`Pagination.Button`), and a rows-per-page selector (`Pagination.PageSize`).

examples.name: Buttons
examples.summary: `Pagination.Button` kinds (previous / next / number / more) and states: default, selected (current page), and disabled. The buttons are butted into one segmented strip — the frame, border and end radii come from the `Pagination` root, so a consumer composes the buttons and nothing else.

examples.name: DataDriven
examples.summary: Data-driven mode: pass `total` and bind `v-model:page` / `v-model:page-size`. The Pagination renders its own info text, windowed page numbers, overflow ellipsis, and the rows-per-page selector, emitting `update:page` / `update:pageSize`.
